FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 208
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Shay Shelnutt
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/02/2026
Senate Bill 208 as introduced could decrease the administrative obligations of the Department
of Finance to hold public hearings for petitions by state rural electric authorities and electric
membership corporations to issue bonds or other evidences of indebtedness, which would no
longer be required under this bill.
